articleTitle: A Novel Application Of IoT In Empowering Women Safety Using GPS Tracking Module
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Is it ethically right, if I say women in our society are not able to lead their lives independently even in this modernized era of 2020? A lot number of physical abuse attacks, rape cases, assaulting of women are being reported daily and are going exponentially high especially in the metro cities. The presence of CCTVs is helping in some manner, but when the attack happens there is no way to Figure out the accused. This paper is intended with an idea for women self-reliance using technology, abating the crime rate against women and girls in India. The proposal document illustrates a rapid responding, cost-effective and easy to carry device empowering women a secure and independent life. Where IoT aims at unifying everything, we have designed and implemented the proposed system integrating IoT with SIM 800 GSM module, Force Sensing Resistor, Pulse Sensor, Bluetooth Module, LCD, Resistors, Transistors, Diodes, LED, Arduino UNO, Buzzers, PCB, Breadboards, Transformer, Switch, Arduino Compiler, and Neo6mv2 GPS module. The proposed system has a dual security feature using which women in agony can call for help and share her location with their predefined emergency number. She can activate the system in three different mdes as per situation demands, at times she feels she is out in odd hours or insecure. The device can be activated by the victim using panic button or bluetooth module. When the device is activated, pulse sensor, GPS module and GSM module incorporated in it automatically gets activated and the system will broadcast the message alert with latitude and longitude dimensions along with the heart rate measure to the authorized predefined numbers and to the police, concurrently will sound a buzzer relentlessly, lenient nearby comprehend with the happening. ForceSensing Resistor is equipped in this device, in case of any external force experienced by the device during any type of misconduct and mishandling. In the era of pepper spray, smart bands, this device is turned out to be more powerful and efficient in insulating the lives against barbarities cause to women.

articleTitle: Application of Neurological Networks in an AI for Chess Game
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Neurological networks in an AI is the term used for mapped networks generated by an artificial intelligence, they are inspired by the biological neural networks and are a form of connectionism a term used for model behavior and mental phenomena. These systems learn and grow by seeing or processing various examples for doing a task without actually doing specific programming for the same the network will learn and grow according to the set of instructions provided to it by the programmer and modify itself to recognize and create patterns based on the requirements. The aim is to create an ultimate chess game that can learn using image modulation techniques and play against a real human. The initial data set for learning was provided using the ultimate chess guide as well as number of games against human and itself.

articleTitle: IoT Based Real Time Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) based Real Time Health Monitoring System is designed with the goal of reducing the stress and movement of sick and exhausted patients. For getting results immediately, IoT based Real time health monitoring system allows the patients to perform all the required medical tests at the same spot within a short period of time. In this research work, all the six testing devices were merged which is kind of a broad innovation comparing to previous history. According to the survey, most of the patients would prefer to use such kind of devices for the purpose of medical testing. Six individual devices (Thermometer, Blood Pressure, Glucometer, Pulse Oximeter, Heartbeat and ECG) are combined and turned into one device. Firstly, Proteus 8 professional is used to simulate all the individual testing devices and measured the results of the various parameters. After that the six individual circuits were implemented practically by using different sensors with the availability of Arduino and LCD Display. Finally, all the individual circuits were designed and integrated in Printed circuit board (PCB). In addition, an Android app was designed which has the main focus of collecting all the test results from the server. From the main device all the test results were uploaded and then delivered to the server using Global System for Mobile (GSM) module which is connected to the patient's and the doctor's cellphone to submit and check out the test results simultaneously. After the implementation and measuring the results from the main device, the obtained results were quite satisfactory. The system performance was analyzed with various results which is not harmful for human body and also economical which can be suggested depending on the final survey that is conducted to obtain the feedback from the users those who have used the device.

articleTitle: An overview of distributed denial of service and internet of things in healthcare devices
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: The paper aims to provide a summary with a reference to the Internet of Things (IoT) of the distributed denial of service (DDoS). The network research community has known about the denial of service (DoS), which is intended to stop legitimate users from accessing a particular network tool since the early 1980s. The aim of the paper is to define DDoS scope, classifications and opportunities for assailants who use IoT to conduct such operations and to use IoT in healthcare. The research approach is to analyze DDoS, IoT and the use of IoT literature in the health sector. The study found that DDOS attacks on IoT-specific devices have become a very easy phenomenon because network attacks are much simpler due to limited security protocols. IOT distribution companies have made limited efforts to enable security of these devices and protecting the data, thus making them susceptible to vulnerabilities. Due to weak security layers, the confidentiality, authenticity and integrity of private data collected by IoT devices are threatened by attackers. The current research identified the gap and importance for further research to provide a mechanism for detection and prevention of DDOS attack in the application layer of IoT healthcare devices in India. Considering the major challenges in IOTs in defending against external attacks and hacking, it is important that they have inherent frameworks warding off such attacks.

articleTitle: Device to Device Communication using Stackelberg Game Theory approach
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: The constant growth in the heterogeneous devices needs to enhance the network capability to fulfill the increased demand of the users. Such a huge number of devices require higher sum rates, superior throughput, system capacity, minor delay, and QoS. The accessible resources are finite and must be flexibly utilized by the subscribers and operators with the expanding requirement. The objective of the paper is to analyze the resource allocation aspects of D2D communication. Furthermore, discuss a game theory approach mainly focuses on the Stackelberg game for resource allocation in the heterogeneous network and how it affects system performance and throughput.

articleTitle: E-Health Bot to change the Face of Medicare
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Chatbot or conversational bot is a tool to ease the communication between human beings and computers. When someone talks to a chatbot, it seems as if you are talking to an actual human being. Chatbots carry out conversation in auditory and textual manner. Chatbots work on the principles of Artificial Intelligence and are automated devices. Their response is based upon the input of the user. They analyze the request, identify intent and entities and then compose their reply which may be data from the database or an API (application programming interface) call. These devices are trained with the help of actual data. The device matches the questions asked by the user to the best suitable answer using tools and models of machine learning. Chatbots seem to be self-sufficient after they go live but human intervention is very crucial in its configuration, training and implementation. Since the database for outputs is limited, it is possible that chatbot encounters an unknown query which is to be solved by a human being. However, chatbots do hold an advantage over human beings as they are available 24/7 and have access to huge amount of information. These chatbots use API for providing response to different requests of the user. This paper proposes the idea of a new chatbot which will assist the users with their medical needs, the Medicbot. This chatbot will be able to perform multiple functions with the combination of various Artificial Intelligence forms such as semantic understanding and natural language processing. Medicbot will be operated with the help of a virtual assistance (serves the purpose of a personal assistant) known as Medico.

articleTitle: Data visualization of crimes in a city using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: This project is all about visualization of crime in a city. From this we can get the knowledge about data that can be visualised through different tools and technologies. Visualised data can be more informative and well understandable rather than clustered format of raw files like CSV files. From this particular data we can see that the crime rate from 2010 to present in New York city is different in various areas and from this we can see clearly in which area what is happening to what kind of people and where it is happening.From this project we can see the Compstat of data which is very beneficial for future predictions for everyone for any purpose.

articleTitle: Analysing Political Bias in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: India is the greatest world-wide democracy system having the largest number of citizens as voters. Our country is additionally the place that is known for the most day by day distributions. The media houses have an adequate measure of users in the nation.These media portals are celebrated for their fast reporting but their political biasing is often fairly evident. Social media is a driving force behind the integration of news media and politics. Political news on social media platforms influences people’s perception of political figures. This propagation can be both helpful and harmful to our community. In our research, attempt is made to reveal inclination of news channels getting biased towards a political party, which can mislead the viewers. An objective watcher, knowing the accurate degree of the predisposition, can understand that in many cases terrible news isn’t accounted for and the uplifting news is misrepresented. To decipher every bit of such information available in the public domain can be quite useful in predicting the outcome of an election. The goal of our research is to build an analyzer capable of detecting political bias from twitter tweets of these news channels. With the help of web scraping and data mining techniques, this information can be captured in both structured and unstructured form at an unprecedented scale and analyzed to predictbias.

articleTitle: Application of Multi Criteria Decision Making in E-commerce sector
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: E-commerce websites have revolutionized the way the Indian customers buy products. In this study, we have compared the market presence of different e-commerce websites based on different criteria that represent various facets of customers’ satisfaction. These criteria are identified according to their relevance and opinions of various experts about the ecommerce websites on these criteria are collected. The paper is based on the application of three Multi Criteria Decision making approaches viz Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process, Fuzzy TOPSIS and PROMETHEE II for selecting the top-rated online shopping platform.

articleTitle: Prediction of Thorax Diseases Using Deep and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: A chest X-ray is often among the principal method that the patients experience when their specialists suspect a lung disease. Sometimes, striking insights about the malady in the x-beams go unnoticed by the radiologists or restorative inspectors and just when these x-beams are reexamined, the sicknesses appearances are found, therefore a great deal of time is squandered. This paper includes deep learning and transfer learning procedures connected for modernized forecast of fourteen thoracic infections to be specific Atelectasis, Consolidation, Infiltration, Pneumothorax, Edema, Emphysema, Fibrosis, Effusion, Pneumonia, Pleural thickening, Cardiomegaly, Nodule Mass, Hernia utilizing the data-set given by NIH clinic center. Keywords-Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Transfer learning, Thoracic diseases, Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN), Medical Imaging

articleTitle: Analysing the effect of modulation schemes and subcarriers on PAPR influence of Hybrid combination of Selective Mapping, Partial Transmit Sequence and Clipping
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) has been a promising multiplexing scheme used for different latest wireless technologies like LTE and New Radio. But it has a major issue of High peak to power ratio (PAPR) that reduces the efficiency of non-linear devices used in OFDM system. As seen in literature, there are number of techniques that are used to reduce PAPR influence on OFDM signal. Selective Mapping (SLM), Partial Transmit Sequence (PTS) and Clipping are some significant techniques that show good performance. In this paper, we analyzed the PAPR performance of a Hybrid SLM and PTS technique for different number of subcarriers. Then, we combined this Hybrid SLM and PTS technique with Clipping and analyzed the performance in terms of PAPR reduction value. Further, the effect of different modulation schemes on this Hybrid combination is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot For Path Planning Using Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Firefly Algorithm is a meta-heuristic algorithm for global optimization, which is inventiveneted by flashing behavior of firefly insects. It has become an augmented optimization tool of Swarm Intelligence to solve the diverse problems. This is performed for any binary combination of fireflies in the population, on every iteration of algorithm.

articleTitle: Redefining Efficiency of TCAS for Improved Sight through Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: This paper focuses on implementing and upgrading the TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) unit on aircraft by adding new input parameters to ensure better safety. It would help understand the air traffic and ground clearance. Sight is one of the tools useful that is present in a pilot's arsenal. It is highly important to make the right decisions quickly. Using the concept presented in this paper we can understand how sight can be improved to ensure safety. This helps the crew to work with the aircraft more easily during emergencies and reduce their burden as they try to keep the aircraft airborne. This also allows for ease of flight and increases the information received to an aircraft. This information can be used to help pilots rely on the TCAS in the case of an Altimeter, GPWS (Ground Proximity Warning System), and ND(Navigational Display) failure. It also would allow for better take-off and landing capabilities using image processing, where a pilot can land and take off without any interference to any air traffic and ground clearance. With the help of the Object Detection Method in Image Processing, we can evaluate the image taken and analyze the information that is received to evaluate the distance to the target and identify it as a risk and if any reaction needs to be taken. This will allow the pilot to take precautions or react to a situation in an accurate manner. This helps identify risks quicker and also ensure the resolutionary advisor gives few or no reversal. This will allow for better assistance to the pilots.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Multi-criteria Decision Making Approach to reorient the use of Triple Bottom Line Model for Sustainable Solutions in Electronic Waste Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: In this modern era where advancement is continuously reshaping the world, technology is rapidly shifting towards sustainable solutions. The traditional framework for sustainable development, the triple bottom line model, focuses not only on economic aspects, but also on ecological and social aspects. It encourages corporations to maintain a balance among these three factors to achieve sustainability, but practically many organizations have failed to do so. This paper provides a review of sustainable development taking into consideration the triple bottom line model. An extension of the triple bottom line model is proposed. The paper addresses the problem of electronic waste generation by keeping in mind the choices made by people, collected from the data attained through a survey. With the intent to solve this problem, Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process of Multi-criteria Decision Making is used to attain sustainability regarding an electronic product. The objective of the paper is to focus on different criteria, prioritize them according to the weight assigned to them to obtain sustainability and gain competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model Considering Depreciation under Two Parameter Weibull Distribution Deterioration: Base for Computing Software
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: The present paper on inventory modeling is only a branch of Operation Research which may be treated as a branch of mathematics education. Inventory models with constant demand have been extensively studied in the inventory literature. In the present paper the previously studied research work is reconsidered taking price-dependent demand pattern in a power law form and a two-parameter Weibull distribution to represent the distribution of time to depreciation. The present paper includes the analytical development and solution of the proposed model. A numerical example has been discussed to illustrate the solution procedure and the sensitivity analysis of the solution is then carried out. Finally the convexity condition of e cost function and actual computational procedure of few important results have been shown in I, II, III Appendices. Sensitivity analysis depicts the extent to which the optimal solution of the model is affected by changes or errors in its input parameter values. The model forms a base for development of a computing software for real industry application.

articleTitle: Nano Power CMOS Current and Voltage Reference with Subthreshold Condition for RF-Powered systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: This article shows a complete CMOS Voltage Reference(VREF) centered on a topology that is self-biasing topology, storing silicon area and providing small current consumption. Temperature adjustment or compensation is accomplished through a technique of settling the transistors in subthreshold and triode(linear) region and also by appropriate setting of active load. The power supply range through which the circuit operates properly is from 600 mV to 650 mV, provides a reference voltage(VREF) of about 320 mV to 350 mV alongwith a temperature, which ranges in between -30°C and 30°C and also a normal range of temperature coefficient having value 100 ppm/°C and the complete consumption of current is under 20 nA. A complete layout for the proposed circuit is also presented in this article. This efficiency leaves the voltage reference suggested for RF-powered application very appropriate.

articleTitle: Design and Testing of a Mobile BPM and Peripheral Oxygen Saturation Monitoring for Patients in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: This paper presents the findings of a successfuldesign and testing for a prototype of a wearable band that can be used to monitor heart beats per minute (BPM), peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO2), and temperature for patients in Bangladesh. In the mobile app version, this sensor data can be converted from text to speech with the press of a button. The device can also send alerts to a person of choice with the patient's current geographic position and locates the nearest hospital from that position. The prototype was compared with a hospital certified device and the results were quite promising. The uniqueness of this design is also highlighted in this paper by comparing the features and results with similar research work.

articleTitle: An Overview of Data Locality Based Scheduler in Hadoop MapReduce Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: MapReduce is a processing framework used extensively for substantial set of data set. Default MapReduce schedulers are not efficient enough to process data sets of heterogeneous nature. Thereby, it leads to low performance and reduced data locality. Working in a heterogeneous environment require more memory, power and advance architecture and computation. This paper provides the outline on MapReduce scheduling, how it is affected by the data locality and heterogeneous data sets. Examination on data locality based scheduling mechanism is done, that aims in reducing the job's running time or CPU time and increases the efficiency, bandwidth and throughput of the cluster i.e. enhancing the overall performance of the Hadoop cluster. In addition to these merits, the lack point of this data locality based scheduling approach is also reviewed.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Neural Networks And Stock Market Predictions
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: It is rightly proclaimed that “there are patterns are in everything.” so does apply in symmetry in between the “human brain neurons and it’s simulation in artificial neural network”. ANN is just simply the software implementations of the neuronal structures of our brains. Now the neural network in our ideological brains “made of star dust” is a hugely interconnected network of neurons, just like the interconnection between the galaxies and the universe of observable homo-species, like ANN are the simulation of the observable neural network of our brain. Now, on technical terms neural networks are attempted to mimic and learn about given specific task on the basis of the weighted input and to provide specific output. The Artificial neural network is basically divided into “supervised and unsupervised neural network”. The working model of neural networks is based on the connections. Neural networks learn repeatedly by taking certain input and by application of “activation function “. Learning occurs by repeatedly activating certain neural connections over others, and this reinforces the connections. Neural networks are finding many applications in various industries like beating players in certain games and one of its major applications come in “stock market predictions”, and pattern recognition is also one of its major areas of work. This paper introduces an audit of the neural network and stock market, and its fundamentals, concise history of neural network, about its origin, certain concepts, and its use in stock market world.

articleTitle: An Application Framework for Quantum Computing using Artificial intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence working along with quantum computers provides a whole new domain of smart systems to explore the world of computing. This paper aims at providing a close examination of the very principle applications of quantum computation along with Artificial Intelligence and to view the workings of an AI neural network along with the quantum theory. For a better understanding, a basic introduction to quantum computers along with a significant but straightforward quantum algorithm is addressed. Also, an unbalanced panorama of the field is given using a survey on quantum computation. The paper cites work and knowledge by previous researchers. Using the knowledge as base algorithms and predictions are added and checked for accessing a deeper connection between AI and quantum. Although, most of the pre-given maps are still very rough. Some parts are still unknown and empty. The ultimate aim is to provide a better and powerful method of tapping into the quantum technology. This research work provides an introduction and a glimpse of quantum computation along with examining the relation between quantum theory, AI and quantum computation for the researchers.

articleTitle: Forecasting of electricity production from Solar Energy in India for the next decade
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: With the end goal of moving towards a sustainable economy; India has started the production of electricity with the help of renewable source of energy - Solar Energy, following the target of the National Solar Mission 2022. To achieve this, a rigorous analysis of the pattern of solar energy supply for domestic electricity production is done. There is a possibility of a supply-demand gap, which is expected to increase over the next decade and hence, immediate policy intervention is required. In this research paper, the possible electricity production from solar energy is forecasted up to the year 2030 using Exponential Smoothing & Regression models as short-term forecast. This is done for minimum possibrenele error in error types namely; RMSE, MAD & MSE. The 4th degree regression model shows the least error with RMSE = 0.759, MAD = 0.457 and MSE = 0.577. The gap between the target and the forecast creates an opportunity for investors and policymakers to invest and foster the use of renewable resources to move towards a sustainable economy.

articleTitle: Personalised Heart Monitoring and Reporting System
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Treatment cost for heart ailments is very high and there are people in India who can't bear the cost of general treatment for their heart ailments. Indeed, even there are ones who live in remote places and can't look for a decent specialist. All the customary advancements are presently being updated with the time of web and innovation. Innovation make things look less demanding and advantageous to utilize. Along these lines we intend to apply the Machine Learning algorithms and distinctive classifiers to anticipate the probability of heart diseases and altogether analyze them and give exercises and medications to counteract it. Heart disease is taken into consideration as one of the important reasons of dying across the globe. Most of the cases include lack of money for routine check-up, lack of transportation facilities, although most of the problems can be cured with the help of medications and exercises. With the motive to provide names of medications and appoint exercises for persons to stay healthy and eventually reduce the death toll caused by heart disease, we have analyzed and compared data mining techniques of Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), Generalized Linear Model (GLM). The performance of each of these algorithms were measured and compared with respect to factors like accuracy, confusion matrix, ROC curve, and AUC value. The best algorithm is then used to predict the probability of heart disease on the parameters provided by the user to generate a report with medications to prevent coronary illness and exercises to stay healthy and fit.

articleTitle: Determining the Adoption Index of Electric Vehicles Using Graph Theory Matrix Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) have gained immense representation as a mainstream solution to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and extenuate the effect of the automobile industry on climate change. Through policy changes and a focused shift towards sustainable development, the industry is undergoing an unprecedented transition, with conventional Internal Combustion vehicle sales declining rapidly. While the global EV industry is expanding rapidly, the regional effect is significant, with some markets according near-mainstream status, and others remaining in early-adoption stages. This leaves domestic automakers to come up with forecasts with little relevant data. The main objective of this study is to identify a set of pertinent factors impacting the adoption of EVs at a local level, to determine the adoptability index of such vehicles in India. While current forecasting methods use either qualitative or quantitative factors, this study selects an amalgamation of both, displaying their relative importance. Using the Graph Theory Matrix Approach, a framework has been developed to generate an adoptability index using the selected attributes and sub-attributes. The study is based predominantly on the Indian market, but can be adapted to various regions with a few tweaks, allowing a more localized view than is currently available.

articleTitle: Issuesand Strategies for Modeling Gene Regulatory Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Research, Innovation, Knowledge Management and Technology Application for Business Sustainability (INBUSH)
abstract: The objective of system biology is to develop the empirical mathematical model of biological systems formed by the interactions between various complex biological data. Gene regulatory networks are developed to explain the complex nature of gene regulation using genomic data. This paper discusses the construction of gene regulatory network using multi-omics genomic data. The major focus is on exploring various modeling schemes, issues and challenges in the construction of gene regulatory network. In this paper, the outline of different techniques, their strengths and limitations have been discussed.
